description: Implementation of ConnectServerBackend class handling CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP requests, managing tunnels, and delegating to a non-connect backend.

classes.name: ConnectServerBackend
classes.description: Handles incoming CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP requests, manages tunnels, and delegates other requests to a backend.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response with specified error code.

methods.name: ConnectServerBackend
methods.description: Constructor initializing the backend with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: ~ConnectServerBackend
methods.description: Destructor ensuring all tunnels are closed.

methods.name: InitializeBackend
methods.description: Initializes the backend, always returns true.

methods.name: IsBackendInitialized
methods.description: Checks if backend is initialized, always returns true.

methods.name: SetSocketFactory
methods.description: Sets the socket factory used for tunnels.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Delegates response fetching to the non-connect backend.

methods.name: HandleConnectHeaders
methods.description: Handles CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP headers, opens tunnels or delegates.

methods.name: HandleConnectData
methods.description: Processes data for established tunnels or delegates.

methods.name: CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Closes tunnels and delegates stream closure.
